verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party docs in the evidence only make qualitative speed claims ("Fast LLM inference", tiers to "tune for latency, throughput"). They publish no tokens-per-second figures, latency numbers, benchmarks or load-testing guides. The throughput figures that do appear (491 T/s, 450+ tps) are individual users' anecdotes on Hacker News, not provider-published benchmarks, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims
